response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer (14+ years, BS in CS) with genuine strengths in full-stack product development, testing/craftsmanship culture, and one stint at high-throughput scale (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec in D). However, the resume shows no evidence of the core of this role: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis and bias detection. Scope also skews toward small companies and individual project ownership rather than Principal/IC6-level, multi-workstream influence across large enterprise organizations. He would likely be a strong senior/staff generalist hire, but is a weak match for a growth/experimentation platform principal role.
strengths: 14+ years across web, backend, mobile, and embedded with polyglot depth (TypeScript, C/C++, Java, C#, D)
Proven low-latency, high-volume microservices work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Strong engineering-fundamentals culture: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus open-source tooling, talks, and mentoring
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk experience
No telemetry/metrics platform or statistical/data-analysis track record required for the data-aptitude bar
Scope and influence appear team-level at small orgs, below Principal/IC6 cross-organization expectations

key_factors.factor: Deep, broad engineering experience with some high-scale distributed systems
